title: OP Iron Golem
description: This project adds an OP Iron Golem that drops at least a stack of iron ingots up to two stacks
body:
This Project makes Iron Golems drop up to two stacks when killed. I've tested it and it works. All you have to do is activate this pack in a world that you want and then kill an Iron Golem, and you will get from 64-128 pieces of iron!!
